call_points.text: Greenfield losses were about ₹20 Cr at corporate EBITDA level, including pre-operating losses.
COGS improved about 1%, translating to roughly 1% gross margin improvement.
Paid ₹25 Cr toward acquisition liabilities in Q1FY27.
Payer mix: 63.6% cash, 27.7% insurance and TPA, 8.6% government schemes.
FY27 growth expected at a similar pace to FY26, with EBITDA margins stable despite aggressive greenfield expansion.
High-end cataract procedures rose to 26.3% of total cataract surgeries in FY26 from 22.5% in FY25.
New FY26 branches ran an operating loss of ₹30 Cr, up from ₹21 Cr for FY25 branches; similar drag expected in FY27.
₹195 Cr of loans repaid from IPO proceeds (₹128 Cr in Q4 FY25, ₹67 Cr in H1 FY26), reducing finance cost.
Acquisition-related payouts: ₹60-65 Cr in FY27, ₹60 Cr across FY28-30.
Refractive surgery growth lagged cataract; management seeks insurance support to lift it.
